description: Header file defining functions related to automation event broadcasting in a service. It declares functions to start/stop the event producer and broadcast specific automation events, such as creation, deletion, or modification.

methods.name: startAutomationEventProducer
methods.description: Starts the event producer to enable the Automation Service to emit events.

methods.name: stopAutomationEventProducer
methods.description: Stops the event producer for automation events.

methods.name: broadcastAutomationCreatedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event indicating an automation has been created.

methods.name: broadcastAutomationDeletedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event indicating an automation has been deleted.

methods.name: broadcastAutomationModifiedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event indicating an automation has been modified.
